comparison.objective: Load a gel into an electrophoresis tank with its wells oriented toward the black cathode.
comparison.physical_skill: Handle and orient a delicate gel into a tank, rather than perform impact fracture with rigid hand tools.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies gel seated with wells at the black cathode, but the body, setup, scoring, damage criteria, and all numeric thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Despite sparse evidence, orientation and placement of a gel is clearly a different tested ability from breaking and recovering HELICOIL tangs.
